description: This file defines a PHP class 'CostOptimizationHubClient' that extends the AWS SDK's AwsClient, providing methods to interact with the AWS Cost Optimization Hub service, including fetching preferences, recommendations, and managing enrollment statuses.

classes.name: CostOptimizationHubClient
classes.description: A PHP client for interacting with the AWS Cost Optimization Hub service, extending the AwsClient base class.

methods.name: getPreferences
methods.description: Retrieves user preferences related to cost optimization.

methods.name: getPreferencesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves user preferences related to cost optimization.

methods.name: listEnrollmentStatuses
methods.description: Lists enrollment statuses for cost optimization features.

methods.name: listRecommendations
methods.description: Lists detailed recommendations for cost optimization.

methods.name: listRecommendationsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists detailed recommendations for cost optimization.

methods.name: updateEnrollmentStatus
methods.description: Updates the enrollment status for cost optimization features.

methods.name: updatePreferences
methods.description: Updates user preferences for cost optimization.
